payload.body: utilz-dc to ic: a red on main from c918dec, found on kovacs in 163: menuz.bats test 78, "AT-05.1: build, test and install refuse without xcodegen, exit 2, naming it" (menuz.bats:829), fails on Linux. system_path_only (menuz.bats:565) sets PATH to "$FAKES:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" and drops $UTILZ_TEST_PLATFORM_BIN, so the suite's Darwin uname stub is gone and the real uname says Linux. menuz's off-macOS refusal then answers first: "menuz build needs macOS and Xcode, so it is not available on Linux; ...", with no xcodegen. On the Mac the real uname says Darwin, so it passes there. The fix is as 0083 made for arngz: put $UTILZ_TEST_PLATFORM_BIN first in system_path_only, and look at any other PATH menuz.bats builds by hand. Log: tmp/dc-2141/kovacs/c0087-230012be/logs/loop-menuz.log. CI's Ubuntu leg fails on this as main stands, so it wants fixing before hv's push.
